verdict.rationale: Daytona is a programmable sandbox platform with SDKs, a CLI and an MCP server, so issuing scoped API credentials for agents is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents API keys with scopes, permissions or least-privilege restrictions. The only credential-related item is token-based SSH access to sandboxes, which is a different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
